changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwnphiespayers AS SELECT np.id, np.nphies_id, np.name_en, np.name_ar, np.is_active, np.created_by, np.created_date, np.last_modified_by, np.last_modified_date FROM public.nphies_payers np;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwnphiespayers TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwnphiespayers FROM report_user;
